sentences.en: In the font business you must never trust anybody!
sentences.zh: 在字体行业你永远不能相信任何人！

sentences.en: The usual fonts for Roman script are too rigid and unflowing.
sentences.zh: 罗马字母常用的字体太僵硬、不流畅。

sentences.en: Serif fonts are prettier, but sans-serif fonts are easier to read.
sentences.zh: 衬线字体更漂亮，但无衬线字体更容易阅读。

senses.zh: 字体,字形,圣洗池（设于教堂中，常为石造）,（同样字体和字号的）一副铅字
